timestamp_scope: Plans were saved and hashed locally before their respective runs. This GitHub commit was made after execution and is NOT external preregistration.

followup.reason: Match false-promotion risk as well as evidence count; test family-level multiplicity after inspecting the initial weak-signal result.

stopping: Fixed simulation counts; no threshold changes to obtain PASS. Individual evidence processes are evaluated at first crossing or maximum evidence horizon.
truth_boundary: Fitted policies and gate do not read evaluation truth. Learned zero nonlinear amplitude is not assumed to be the null of policy value.
